requirement.description: The RLP encoding/decoding implementation has several critical issues causing multiple test failures. The implementation is incomplete and contains duplicate function definitions. Several test cases are failing due to incorrect encoding/decoding logic and hex conversion errors.

behavior.input: Accept various data types (strings, integers, lists) with str_mode parameter
behavior.output: Return properly formatted RLP-encoded hex string
behavior.error_handling: Handle invalid hex strings gracefully with ValueError

behavior.input: Accept RLP-encoded binary data with types parameter
behavior.output: Return decoded data in appropriate format based on types parameter
behavior.error_handling: Handle invalid RLP data gracefully with ValueError

requirement.description: The keccak hashing implementation in the hashes module fails when using hashlib on systems where hashlib.keccak_256 is not available (Python versions before 3.9). This causes test failures in EVM address utilities that rely on keccak hashing.

behavior.input: Accept binary data and output format specification
behavior.output: Return keccak-256 hash in specified format (hex, binary, integer)
behavior.error_handling: Provide fallback mechanisms when primary keccak libraries are unavailable

behavior.input: Accept text data and output format specification
behavior.output: Return keccak-256 hash of text in specified format
behavior.error_handling: Handle text encoding properly and provide fallbacks

requirement.description: The binary module's functions for signing and recovery are not fully implemented, causing failures in signature-related tests. The functions exist but return hardcoded values or incomplete implementations.

behavior.input: Accept message hash, private key, and chain ID
behavior.output: Return a signature tuple (v, r, s)

requirement.description: There are duplicate function definitions in the rlp_coding.py file, which will cause import errors and prevent proper functionality.

behavior.input: Remove duplicate function definition and ensure single implementation
behavior.output: Single, working implementation of RLP decoding
behavior.error_handling: No duplicate functions to cause import issues
